endpoint_device_evidence.connection_policy: No endpoint is enumerated or opened. A later host may explicitly select an input whose identity has been verified as the regular Launch Control 3 Custom Mode 1 port.
endpoint_device_evidence.notes: Repository topology and synthetic messages prove protocol transforms only. They do not prove endpoint identity, receipt, encoder behavior, firmware mode, reconnect, LEDs, or physical usefulness. The regular Launch Control 3 has no faders and none are inferred.
